newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Lenenergo workers say ready to strike.
newsitem.headline: Lenenergo workers say ready to strike.

text.p: Workers at Russian power utility AO Lenenergo are ready to strike over unpaid wages, the company's trade union said on Wednesday.
"We are calling for the authorities to pay attention to energy workers' problems and try to break the non-payment knot," the union said in a statement.
Lenenergo spokeswoman Svetlana Matveyeva told Reuters that workers had not received their September wages.
"There have been problems with wages payments since May, but on September 19 after the tax office froze Lenenergo accounts, wages payments were stopped altogether," she said.
The tax office froze Lenenergo accounts to write off the company's tax debt.

The company failed to pay taxes after its customers failed to pay for electricity -- a typical situation in Russia, where many people and companies are not paying their bills, creating a web of non-payments.
About two weeks ago power workers at power utility Dalenergo in the Maritime region went on hunger strike to protest against months of wage arrears.
